blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — The third National Surf Summit and Competition opened Thursday at Bagasbas Beach in Daet town, Camarines Norte, with 269 competitors taking part in a six-day event promoting safe and sustainable surf tourism in the country. “Bicol is blessed with some of the country’s incredible surfing destinations—from the powerful waves of Camarines Norte and Catanduanes to the surfing gems of Sorsogon,” said Herbie Aguas, Department of Tourism (DOT) Bicol director, in a phone interview Thursday. He said surfers and surfing enthusiasts from established surfing destinations, including Siargao, Baler, Zambales, Samar, Quezon and La Union, were expected to participate in […]...
